g.title: Catchall storefront resolves bags, luggage, categories and collection routes.
Store provider and cart page send server cart / checkout requests.
Actual client/server routes documented in the route inventory.
Services return current catalog, bag, quote and order data.
State updates follow API results, with loading and error UI.
Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.
Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.
Customer account section backed by actual account, care, order or review APIs. Address book is a separate component.
